sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-Base model card
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies a pretrained-only checkpoint for fine-tuning and research, with a vision encoder, nominal 9B language model and 262144 native context. Generic post-training and MoE passages conflict with the exact-variant description/configuration.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-Base configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; 32 text layers alternate three linear-attention layers with one full-attention layer, dense FFNs, a vision encoder, image/video token IDs, one MTP layer, and 262144 positions.

sources.title: Official checkpoint metadata and Safetensors parameter count
sources.evidence: Public checkpoint metadata reports 9653100528 BF16 plus 3840 F32 parameters, totaling 9653104368; repository created February 26, 2026.

sources.title: Official checkpoint index and linked tensor headers
sources.evidence: All four linked shard headers were read with byte ranges and tensor-shape products summed: language backbone 7936684544, LM head 1017118720, vision 456010480, MTP 243290624; total 9653104368.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-Base license
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint repository distributes the Apache License, Version 2.0.

sources.title: Base checkpoint tokenizer and chat template
sources.evidence: Template renders text, images, video, tool calls and an enable_thinking branch; this establishes template syntax, not instruction-tuned behavior of the pretrained-only weights.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository news and developer attribution
sources.evidence: The renamed official Qwen3.5 repository attributes development to Alibaba and dates availability of the 9B/4B/2B/0.8B series to March 2, 2026; the entry does not explicitly identify the Base variants.

sources.title: Exact Base checkpoint commit history
sources.evidence: Initial repository commit February 26; checkpoint folder upload February 27; subsequent changes before March 2. Commit timestamps do not establish when the repository became public.

sources.title: Qwen-Scope: Decoding Intelligence, Unleashing Potential
sources.evidence: The search-indexed official April 29 article explicitly places the Qwen3.5-9B-Base backbone in its Dense group. Indexed text was available; opening the live JavaScript page returned no article text.

sources.title: Initial Base repository tree
sources.evidence: The February 26 initial revision contains only .gitattributes and a 31-byte README, with no model weights.

name.note: Catalog spacing preserves the official Qwen3.5-9B-Base identity.

developer.note: The official Qwen repository identifies the Qwen team within Alibaba Group.

family.note: Qwen3.5 is a member of the Qwen family.

release_date.note: February 26 is repository creation without weights; upload was February 27. Official news gives March 2 for the small-model series, but exact Base public availability is not established by the accessed primary sources.

open_weights.note: Exact Base checkpoint weights and tensor headers are publicly accessible.

license.note: Verified against the license file distributed with this checkpoint.

parameters_b.note: Complete published checkpoint count divided by 1e9, independently matching header sums. The nominal 9B label describes the language model; vision and MTP are additional.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-variant active-parameter count is reported. Dense architecture does not justify equating active with total, especially across vision and MTP paths.

architecture.note: Dense feed-forward network with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full-attention layers and a vision encoder; exact configuration and Qwen-Scope classification override generic MoE wording.

context_window.note: Native maximum positions and tokenizer limit agree at 262144; optional context extension is not the native limit.

modalities.note: The exact configuration supplies vision/image/video inputs and conditional text generation; the template implements all three input types.

reasoning.note: The base weights are pretrained-only. A thinking branch in the supplied fine-tuning-compatible template does not establish a supported reasoning mode or verify its absence.

tool_call.note: Tool serialization exists in the supplied template, but the base card does not establish trained tool-calling support or its absence. Clear the unsupported false assertion.

description.value: Pre-trained Qwen3.5 base checkpoint for fine-tuning and research, without instruction tuning
description.note: The variant-specific pretrained-only statement supports this description despite the contradictory generic training-stage bullet.

patch.notes: Complete checkpoint: 9.653104368B parameters, including 8.953803264B language model with output head, 0.456010480B vision and 0.243290624B MTP. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. Dense FFNs accompany hybrid DeltaNet/full attention. Base weights are pretrained-only; generic card post-training/MoE claims and chat-template branches do not establish trained reasoning or tool capabilities. February 26 is repository creation, February 27 is weight upload, and March 2 is the official small-series announcement; exact Base public release remains unverified.

summary: Correct total from nominal 9B language size to the complete 9.653104368B checkpoint, verify dense hybrid architecture, and preserve undisclosed active parameters. Clear unsupported reasoning/tool-call false flags and the repository-creation release date. Confirm open weights, Apache-2.0, native 262144 context, multimodal inputs and pretrained-only description. Exact Base public release remains unresolved.
